text: Congrats on the house. I still owe you a ladder from 2019 when you helped me move — it's yours now.

text: New place looks good. The radiator in the back room clanks; ours did too, a quarter turn on the bleed valve fixes it.

text: Congrats on the keys. Save the moving boxes — Priya needs them in September.

text: Congrats, you two. The tent we borrowed for our honeymoon leaks at the left seam — flagging so yours doesn't.

label: human
text: So happy for you both. First dance song was the one from the road trip, wasn't it? Called it in 2021.

text: Congrats! Sorry I cried during the vows. And the toast. And the part with the rings.

text: Married! Wild. I remember the night you two argued about crossword clues for three hours and I knew.

text: Wish you two a good first year. Ours was mostly furniture arguments and takeout; you'll be fine.

text: Welcome, little Theo. Your mom already lost the first sock. It begins.

text: Congrats on the baby. Casserole's in your freezer, 40 minutes at 375. Don't microwave it, it goes soupy.

text: Happy last day. The printer will break for good the week after you leave, and then everyone will understand what you did here.

label: human
text: Good luck at the new place. Take the whiteboard eraser — you brought it, and it's the only one that works.

text: You're really leaving. Who fixes the coffee machine now? I watched you do it twice and learned nothing.

label: human
text: Enjoy it. The garden won't know what hit it. Send tomatoes in August.

text: 09:41 first alert. 09:55 we blamed the wrong service and lost 20 minutes. 10:32 restart fixed it.

text: Root cause: the cert on the internal proxy expired at midnight UTC. Renewal cron had been disabled since the March migration.

label: human
text: Root cause: a config push set the retry limit to 0 instead of 3. Typo in a YAML file, reviewed by two people, caught by neither.

label: human
text: The queue backed up because one consumer pinned a CPU parsing a 900MB message we should have rejected at ingest.

label: human
text: Guard added: deploys now block if the canary's p99 exceeds 400ms for five minutes. Would have caught this at 13:47.

label: human
text: Guard added: the archiver refuses to delete anything under 30 days old, hard-coded, no override flag.

label: human
text: Still unknown: why the failover took 9 minutes instead of the 40 seconds we measured in the drill. Dan is bisecting the health-check timing.

label: human
text: Still unknown: which client sent the malformed batch. Logs rotated before we thought to save them. Retention bumped to 14 days.

label: human
text: Impact: 4,300 users saw errors for 22 minutes. 61 orders failed and were refunded manually by Friday.

label: human
text: Impact: exports were stale for six hours. Nobody noticed until a customer emailed. We had no alert on export age; now we do.

label: human
text: Timeline: 02:10 disk hit 100% on db-3. 02:14 writes stalled. 02:41 on-call woke up, freed 80GB of old WAL, writes resumed.

label: human
text: What went wrong: I merged the schema change and the code change in one PR. Rollback reverted both, which broke reads for 12 minutes.

label: human
text: What went wrong: the runbook said to restart in order A, B, C. It's actually C first. Doc fixed, and we rehearsed it Tuesday.

label: human
text: The dashboard showed green the whole time because it averages across regions. eu-west was fully down and the average hid it.

label: human
text: Fix shipped in 2.14.1: the client now backs off exponentially instead of retrying every 200ms, which is what melted the API.

label: human
text: We paged the wrong team for 25 minutes because the escalation policy still listed the old squad. Updated same day.

label: human
text: Duration 47 minutes, 31 of which were us confirming it wasn't the load balancer. It was never the load balancer.

label: human
text: The batch job ran twice because the lock file lives on a disk that got remounted. Moved the lock into the database.

text: Action item: add a staging replica of the payments sandbox. We tested against prod because staging didn't have one. Owner: Priya, due 8/22.

label: human
text: Action item: alert when the sync lag passes 10 minutes, not 60. At 60 we're already fielding tickets.

label: human
text: Contributing factor: the feature flag defaulted to on in the new environment. Every new environment now starts with all flags off.

label: human
text: Contributing factor: both on-call engineers were in the same meeting with phones on silent. Pager now escalates after 5 minutes, not 15.

text: Detection was the worst part: customers told us before our alerts did, 18 minutes earlier. Synthetic checks added for the three busiest flows.

text: The rollback itself failed because the previous image had been garbage-collected. We now keep the last five images, pinned.

text: 11:20 memory climbing on both workers. 11:34 OOM kill. 11:36 second OOM. 11:50 capped the upload size at 50MB, stable since.

text: Root cause: DNS TTL was set to 24 hours, so half the fleet kept resolving to the dead node all afternoon.

text: I approved the change at 17:40 on a Friday. That was the mistake. Deploy window now closes at 15:00 Fridays.
